campus_notes: Compiled 2026-09-14 from University of Arizona Housing & Residential Life's official dorm pages. Arizona is one of the most thoroughly documented housing sites in the country: nearly every hall publishes exact room dimensions and square footage per room type alongside measured closet, desk, dresser, window and doorway sizes, bed-to-bed spacing and outlet counts, so almost every room here is high confidence taken straight from those pages. Arizona notes that room measurements may vary. Most beds are extra-long twin (38" x 80"); Hopi uses full-size beds and the Honors Village 4BR/4BA apartments offer a Full XL option, both flagged on the room because Twin XL bedding will not fit. Suites and apartments are modeled per bedroom.
